opportunities.name: Expedia rental car search by airport or city
opportunities.description: Search for a rental car on Expedia by entering a pick-up location, pick-up and drop-off dates, and pick-up and drop-off times, then run the search and optionally filter the results.
steps: Open the Expedia home page and click the 'Cars' tab.
Click the 'Pick-up' field, type the airport or city, and choose the matching suggestion.
Leave 'Same as pick-up' for drop-off, or type a different drop-off location and choose a suggestion.
Click the pick-up date field, select the start date and end date in the calendar, and click 'Done'.
Open the pick-up time and drop-off time dropdowns and choose the times.
Click 'Search'.
On the results page, optionally tick car-type, rental-company, or passenger filters, or change the sort.
parameters: optional result filters (car type, company, passengers)

instances.values: Pick-up JFK (New York), drop-off same as pick-up; default dates Apr 5–6 and default 10:30 am times. Ends while the drop-off field was being searched; no search was submitted.
Pick-up JFK (New York), drop-off JFK; pick-up Apr 3, drop-off Apr 6; pick-up 9:00 am, drop-off 6:00 pm. Search submitted at 2202.9, then the results were filtered (Luxury, 2-5 passengers) and sorted.
Pick-up San Francisco, drop-off same; pick-up Apr 8, drop-off Apr 9; default 10:30 am times. Search submitted at 2984.8, then results were filtered to Avis.

opportunities.name: Booking.com flight search with ticket selection
opportunities.description: Search flights on Booking.com for a one-way or multi-city trip with given origins, destinations, dates, and passenger count, sort by fastest, and step through fare selection to the Next page.
steps: Open the Booking.com home page and click the 'Flights' tab.
Select the trip type: 'One way', 'Round trip', or 'Multi-city'.
Click the origin field, type the city or airport, and choose the suggestion.
Click the destination field, type the city or airport, and choose the suggestion.
For multi-city, click 'Add a flight' and enter each leg's origin, destination, and date.
Open the date field, pick the departure date (and return date if round trip), and close the calendar.
Open the passengers dropdown, set the number of adults, and click 'Done'.
Optionally tick 'Direct flights only'.
Click 'Search', then click the 'Fastest' tab.
Click 'See flight', click 'Select' in the baggage popup, choose a ticket type, and click 'Next'.
parameters: trip type (one way, round trip, multi-city)

instances.values: One way; origin Bangalore (BLR) replacing Columbus; destination Goa Panaji (GOI); Wed 29 Mar 2023; 2 adults; direct flights only; Fastest sort; Standard ticket shown then Flexible selected and Next clicked.

Multi-city; leg 1 New York (from Columbus) to Tokyo, Thu 1 Jun; leg 2 Tokyo to Delhi (DEL), Mon 5 Jun; 1 adult; direct flights only; Fastest sort; Standard ticket shown then Flexible selected and Next clicked.

opportunities.name: Carnival cruise search by region, port, month, and guests
opportunities.description: Search Carnival cruises by choosing a destination region, a sail-from port, a sailing month, and then adjusting the guest count on the results page.
steps: On the promotional cruise page, open the 'Sail To' dropdown and click the destination region (for example 'Panama Canal' or 'Caribbean').
Open the 'Sail From' dropdown and click the departure port.
Open the 'Dates' dropdown and click the sailing month and year.
Click 'Search Cruises'.
On the results page, open 'Number of Guests' and use the + or - buttons to set the count.
Read the results for the chosen cruise.

instances.values: Sail To Panama Canal; Sail From San Francisco, CA; Dates Oct 2024; search returned 1 cruise (15-day Panama Canal from San Francisco).
Sail To Caribbean; no port or month set; guests changed 2 → 3 → 4 on the results page. The flow was interrupted at about 1009–1078 by Kohl's browsing, then resumed on the Carnival results page.

opportunities.name: MTA planned service changes lookup by route and date
opportunities.description: Look up planned subway service changes on the MTA site by entering a route name and a date, then reading the results.
steps: Click 'Planned Work' in the MTA top navigation (or open the menu and choose 'Planned Service Changes').
Click the 'Search Routes' field, type the route ID, and choose the suggestion.
Click 'Select routes'.
Click the 'Select Date' field, navigate to the required month, and click the day.
Read the 'Results for' section.

instances.values: Route S92 typed, date left at default 04/07/2023; the route suggestion was being selected when the recording ends.
Route 4 selected (1 route), date changed from 04/12/2023 to May 3, 2023; results showed no planned service changes for this line.

opportunities.name: SpotHero airport parking search
opportunities.description: Search for airport parking on SpotHero by selecting an airport and entering a start and end date, then running the search.
steps: On the SpotHero home page, click the 'Airport' tab.
Click the 'Search Name, Code or City' field and choose the airport from the list.
On the results page, click 'Parking Start Date' and choose the start date.
Click 'Parking End Date' and choose the end date.
Click 'Search'.
Optionally change the 'Featured' sort.

instances.values: Airport JFK (John F. Kennedy International); start Apr 18, end Apr 20, 2023; results sorted by Featured.
Airport Dallas Love Field (DAL) selected; the date and search steps are not shown in the recording, so this instance is partial.
